Luvdisc

Water

Hoenn · Generation 3

Luvdisc is a Water-type Rendezvous Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 0.6 m tall and weighs 8.7 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Speed (97), with a base stat total of 330.
